item.tib: dbal phur sman bsgrubs la nye bar mkho ba'i zur phyung bde ba'i yan lag
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ltar dgos chad (ched) dbal phur sman sgrab 'od zer 'bar ba la ma tshang kha bskang spyi spungs sman 'chang ('phyong) nas byed srol 'dug kyang/ lha mtshan kha sgyar sogs yid brtan ma snyed (rnyed) pa/ rgyud lung dang mthun pa zhig dgos zhes g.yung drung 'o tshal gling gi dbu mdzad bAM btsun tshul khrims dge ba nas bskul ba dang/ ma zad phur rgyud me ri 'bar ba las/ zhi drag lha 'khor tshang par sman 'dzab sprod pa'i lung gi (gis) zin/ mkhas 'dod ma yin bstan 'gror lhag bsam dag pas blos bskul te/ tshul 'di byed po lung zin sems dpa' yongs kyi tha shar (shal) pa/ gshen gyi sprul ming kun mkhyen thugs rje nyi mas bkra shis lha steng gnas su smin grol bon 'chad pa'i thun mtshams su lung rig sdeb ste (bsdebs te) khrigs su bsgrig pa 'di dag 'gal gnong ci mchis dbal phur lha la bshags/ dge des dbal phur sman bsgrubs (sgrub) la nye bar mkho ba'i zur phyung bde ba'i yan lag
